verses.gurmukhi: ਦਿਨਕਰ ਕਿਰਨਿ ਸੁਹਾਤ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ਅੰਗ ਰਚਤ ਸਿੰਗਾਰ ਅਭਰਨ ਸਖੀ ਆਇ ਕੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: dhinakar kiran suhaat sukhadhaiee a(n)g rachat si(n)gaar abharan sakhee aai kai ||

en.bdb: (Before the girl is married off, the bride is adorned with ornaments and jewellery) and the rays of Sun falling on her, make her look more good. Her friends come to embellish her more.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਿਥਮ ਉਬਟਨਾ ਕੈ ਸੀਸ ਮੈ ਮਲਉਨੀ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਜਨ ਉਸਨ ਜਲ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਭਾਇ ਕੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: piratham ubaTanaa kai sees mai malaunee mel majan usan jal niramal bhai kai ||

en.bdb: Paste of herbs, oil and salts is rubbed on her body, the hair are massaged with scents and oil and then shampooed with lukewarm water. Her body then starts radiating like gold.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੁਸਮ ਅਵੇਸ ਕੇਸ ਬਾਸਤ ਫੁਲੇਲ ਮੇਲ ਅੰਗ ਅਰਗਜਾ ਲੇਪ ਹੇਤ ਉਪਜਾਇ ਕੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: kusam aves kes baasat fulel mel a(n)g aragajaa lep het upajai kai ||

en.bdb: Adoring the hair with flowers, applying the mixture of fragranced and scented mixture on the body, the feeling of romance and love is incited.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚੀਰ ਚਾਰ ਦਰਪਨ ਮਧਿ ਆਪਾ ਆਪੁ ਚੀਨਿ ਬੈਠੀ ਪਰਜੰਕ ਪਰਿ ਧਾਵਰੀ ਨ ਧਾਇ ਕੈ ॥੩੪੬॥
verses.translit_en: cheer chaar dharapan madh aapaa aap cheen baiThee paraja(n)k par dhaavaree na dhai kai ||346||

en.bdb: Wearing beautiful dresses, seeing her beautiful form in the mirror, she occupies the bed of her dear husband. Then her wandering mind does not wander any more and becomes stable and restful. (346)
